summary: USFS tower on the Wallowa-Whitman NF, Union County OR: built 1936 (panorama photos date to 1935), gone by the 1940s; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Gone sometime in the 1940s (firetower.org) and abandoned in the 1940s (firelookout.com); no source describes what remains

access.note: No source describes public access or site condition today

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The panorama is dated March 30, 1935 by the register and September 30, 1935 by Forest Lookouts. Both predate the 1936 build year. Not resolved; the story reports both dates.

notes_for_editor: The brief has no height, and no source gives one, so none is recorded. No staffing source was found. Thin record: three short pages, all agreeing on 1936 and the 1940s. Two web searches found no other Limber Jim sources; a 1936 Kirkland guard station that came up is unrelated and not used. Access is unknown; no source describes the site today.
